 Recirculation Fan

Waagner Biro Austria,
 Soly Vent Venter France

This document outlines the Fan inspection list I1, which must be performed every six month, 
as indicated by M6 in the title block.

The forced fans to supply boiler with combustion air, and gas recirculation fans 
to heat combustion to rise the efficiency of boiler.

The first draft initiated by eng. Abd El-Naeem Attalla Ahmed, tested at 23 March 
2004, accepted by general director eng. Abd El Shafy Ali, revised by EDEPCo. quality 
control eng. Samir Abed El-Gelil,
approved by eng. Deyaa EL-Deen Abu El-Fetouh Yousif; Head Sector of Ataka Power 
Station (2x300 M.W+2x150 M.W), and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al-Lethy: 
EDEPCo. Inspection and quality Control Head Sector.

The technical specification for the types of fan stated at the last page page 
no.

Work order must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should the suitable safety category

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area

ارتداء خوذة السلامة والأحذية, 
 قفازات ... الخ
عزل قاطع الدائرة الكهربائية لمحرك المروحة
Disconnect electric terminals of fan motor

The fan must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery 
 damper

Check alignment for flange of coupling of fans and ensure that 
 is OK
Measure vibration level for bearing as MRDS then analyze it and determine what to do (if it is needed).
Check bolts fixation, tighten if needed.

Check visually the bearings oil for color and viscosity, add or change 
 oil if needed.
Check the tightness of the coupling.

Check that the connecting flanges between the fan and the 
 ducting are good.
Check the oil level of the bearing.
Check that no water in the bottom of the casing.

Return back all mechanical and electrical Fan positions to the normal by 
 coordinating with shift engineer
